d:
Bihar ke begusray se ek behad ganbhir mamla samne aaya hai. pahle samuhik dushkarm ki shikar huee mahila par ab dobara janleva hamla karne ka aarop laga hai.
Pirita ke anusar, use ghar ki chhat se niche phenka gaya, jiske bad ganbhir halat men sadar aspatal men bharti karaya gaya. pulis ne mamle men ek aaropi ko giraphtar kiya hai aur janch jari hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
